purpose: Complete Stage 5.12 by implementing canonical Term wire decode/encode in unchanged NEX-1 v0.1 over the accepted operational representation.

success_contract.decodeTerm: Ok payload is canonical FiniteNatTokens Term v0.3; output tokens are a semantic preorder-token transformation of wire, not an opaque copy/reference to original Bits.
success_contract.encodeTerm: Ok payload is canonical FiniteBits; output wire is reconstructed from Term tokens and must equal NEX-1 v0.1 canonical wire extensionally including EOF at length.

decodeTerm.WireUnexpectedEOF: input finite wire ends before one complete Term is decoded
decodeTerm.WireTrailingData: one complete Term ends before the declared/input stream EOF
decodeTerm.MalformedMeta: reserved for a violated admitted FiniteBits meta-representation invariant; ordinary truncated canonical wire remains WireUnexpectedEOF

encodeTerm.MalformedMeta: Term token sequence is empty, truncated, has an unknown tag, or has trailing tokens after one complete Term

failure_contract.error_payload: canonical empty finite stream/token value; status is the portable discriminator

laws: decodeTerm(encodeTerm(term)) == term for every admitted canonical Term value on the frozen test surface
encodeTerm(decodeTerm(bits)) == canonical(bits) for every successfully decoded canonical wire value on the frozen test surface
function-valued stream equality is extensional over every declared element plus required out-of-range/EOF behavior; observing only Function is never acceptance evidence

candidate_discipline.after_first_candidate_execution: any algorithmic or candidate-wire change requires full-codec candidate v0.2 and a new preregistered holdout
candidate_discipline.holdout_rule: holdout may execute once only after frozen development success, bounded-exhaustive success, unchanged candidate identity, and a green historical checkpoint

go_normative_cbn.role: measurement; refusals recorded separately under the existing Stage 5.12 protocol

bounded_exhaustive_class.generation_rule: all ordered Terms with 1..3 AST nodes whose leaves belong to the frozen leaf_set and whose internal constructors are Lam/App/Let where the node bound permits
required_checks: Direct Go and Direct Python canonical wire agree
NEX decodeTerm accepts canonical wire and returns exactly the canonical token sequence
NEX encodeTerm accepts canonical tokens and returns exactly canonical wire
both Stage 5.12 round-trip laws hold extensionally

forbidden_shortcuts: decodeTerm returning/copying an opaque original wire object instead of canonical Term tokens
encodeTerm delegating constructor/U encoding decisions to a host callback
host AST/list/byte-array used as semantic state inside the NEX candidate
completion_boundary: Stage 5.13 remains blocked until this contract, development, exhaustive class, one-shot holdout, final regression, and documentation review all pass and Stage 5.12 is explicitly marked Complete.
